Flow 3.6.1

Flow 3.6.1 — A simpler icon

A new minimal graphite download mark on a soft white tile replaces the glossy purple logo. The same artwork is used for the Mac app, sidebar, Chrome extension and installer. The original vector source and a reproducible icon renderer are included.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization remain pending.

Flow 3.6.0

Flow 3.6.0 — Finish without rebuilding the download

New downloads write each connection directly into one file at its final byte offset. Completion flushes and renames that file; it does not copy all segments into another full-size file.

Durable offset checkpoints support pause, process crash recovery, automatic connection tuning, expired-link refresh, and moving to another disk. Storage moves copy and verify only saved byte ranges rather than reading untouched sparse holes. Existing segmented downloads retain their tested assembly and recovery path.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization remain pending.

Flow 3.5.0

Flow 3.5.0 — Refresh expired download links

Refresh link… checks a fresh address and resumes saved segments. Paste a replacement URL or choose Use next Chrome link, then send the same file through the Flow Chrome extension. Expired/access-denied errors point to this action.

File size, resume support and the original server validator must match. A rejected address leaves saved parts untouched. Refreshed downloads also preserve parts if the server later changes identity or stops honoring ranges. Servers that change validators require a fresh download; Flow will not merge unverified files.

Developer preview: Apple signing and notarization remain pending.
